caveat: Numerical validation only; not a proof or novelty claim.

conventions.n: boundary ports per partition in physical cases
conventions.S: sum over U x V block, each cross entry counted once
conventions.d: S/n, average output on U under equal unit inputs on V
conventions.within_leak: ordered off-diagonal sums, not unordered edge sums
conventions.exact_bound: d <= r*h*lambda/n^2 when kappa=lambda/n and delta=0
conventions.ramp: derivative is convolution of two uniform probability densities
